paragraphs: IKE sells data acquisition and structural analysis software for power and communication infrastructure. IKE Device speeds up field data collection, and field data uploads to IKE Office Pro for management of pole records. IKE PoleForeman is a structural analysis tool for NESC compliance and pole loading analysis of overhead infrastructure.

The company names utilities, engineering firms, and communications companies among the industries it serves. The about page describes the business as a platform technology company for utility poles and the equipment and services they support. The same page ties those solutions to designing, constructing, and inspecting distribution assets, and to grid resiliency and fiber broadband expansions.

IKE also offers NESC and OSHA training courses for utility and communications workers. The about page lists 500+ enterprise customers across utilities, telecom, and engineering. The same page reports coverage in all 50 states, supporting critical infrastructure nationwide.

quote.text: We help utilities, telecommunication companies, and engineering firms design, manage, and optimize critical overhead infrastructure.
